_note: Single source of truth for scripts/seed.mjs AND for VITE_MOCK mode.
Every row that appears in the product must carry a source_id that exists in source_registry.
Figures verified against the DOSM release page on 3 August 2026.

mortality_context_ranks_2_to_5.what_is_missing: Causes ranked 2nd-5th within the 41-59 age band.
mortality_context_ranks_2_to_5.why: The DOSM release summary publishes only the PRINCIPAL cause for each age band (0-14, 15-40, 41-59, 60+). The full age x cause cross-tabulation is not in the public overview.
mortality_context_ranks_2_to_5.how_to_obtain: Request the age x cause table via DOSM eStatistik (data[at]dosm.gov.my), or extract it from the full publication PDF if the team can access the detailed tables.
mortality_context_ranks_2_to_5.do_not: Do not populate these rows by inference from the national all-ages ranking. The national order (pneumonia 2nd, diabetes 3rd) does NOT necessarily hold within 41-59, and the product must not present an unverified ordering as official.

source_registry.title: Statistics on Causes of Death, Malaysia, 2025 (data refer to 2024)
source_registry.licence: Public reference — store derived facts with attribution; do not mirror the report
source_registry.caveat_en: Of 198,992 deaths registered in 2024, 133,844 (67.3%) were medically certified. These figures describe certified deaths only.

action_content.title: Walk 30 minutes, 5 days a week
action_content.reason: WHO advises adults aged 18–64 to do 150–300 minutes of moderate-intensity activity across the week. Five 30-minute walks is the lower end of that range.
action_content.first_step: Two 15-minute walks after work count as one session.
action_content.safety_note: Start at a level that is safe for you. Ask a clinician first if you have symptoms or a diagnosed condition.

action_content.title: Berjalan 30 minit, 5 hari seminggu
action_content.reason: WHO menyarankan dewasa berumur 18–64 melakukan 150–300 minit aktiviti sederhana seminggu. Lima sesi berjalan 30 minit ialah paras minimum julat itu.
action_content.first_step: Dua sesi berjalan 15 minit selepas kerja dikira sebagai satu sesi.
action_content.safety_note: Mulakan pada tahap yang selamat untuk anda. Rujuk doktor dahulu jika ada simptom atau penyakit yang didiagnos.

action_content.title: Swap one sugary drink for water
action_content.reason: NHMS 2023 reported 15.6% diabetes prevalence among Malaysian adults.
action_content.first_step: Keep a water bottle where you work.
action_content.safety_note: General guidance only. This is not a treatment or a diet prescription.

action_content.title: Tukar satu minuman manis kepada air kosong
action_content.reason: NHMS 2023 melaporkan prevalens diabetes 15.6% dalam kalangan dewasa Malaysia.
action_content.first_step: Letakkan botol air di tempat kerja anda.
action_content.safety_note: Panduan umum sahaja. Ini bukan rawatan atau preskripsi diet.

action_content.title: Book a health screening
action_content.reason: MySejahtera's screening drive targets people aged 40 and above who have not had a health screening in the last 3 years.
action_content.first_step: Check what your nearest Klinik Kesihatan offers.
action_content.safety_note: Eligibility and tests are decided by the health service, not by this app.

action_content.title: Tempah saringan kesihatan
action_content.reason: Kempen saringan MySejahtera menyasarkan mereka berumur 40 tahun ke atas yang tidak membuat saringan kesihatan dalam 3 tahun lepas.
action_content.first_step: Semak perkhidmatan di Klinik Kesihatan berdekatan anda.
action_content.safety_note: Kelayakan dan ujian ditentukan oleh perkhidmatan kesihatan, bukan aplikasi ini.

_verification.method: Each figure read directly from the publisher's own page or PDF, not from a secondary summary. Nothing is inferred, rounded or carried over unchecked.

mortality_context.source: R1 — DOSM release page, quoted verbatim
mortality_context.denominator: All shares are of MEDICALLY CERTIFIED deaths (133,844 of 198,992 registered deaths in 2024).
mortality_context.consistency_check: Implied band totals from the four published age-band shares sum to ~133,912 against the stated 133,844 certified deaths — a 0.05% gap explained by the published percentages being rounded to one decimal.

factor_prevalence.source: R2 — NHMS 2023 Fact Sheet PDF, read directly

quotes.hypercholesterolaemia: Prevalence of hypercholesterolaemia among adults — Overall: 33.3%
quotes.hypertension: Prevalence of hypertension among adults — Overall: 29.2%
quotes.diabetes: Prevalence of diabetes among adults — Overall: 15.6%

plain_language_labels.why: Labels are deliberately plain (feature F06/F17 — 35.1% of adults have low health literacy). This maps each label back to the term used by the source.

_verification.population_context_note: These rows record WHICH age bands the DOSM mortality release publishes, so they are attributed to R1. The DMP intends this table to also hold population denominators from OpenDOSM (R10); those have not been extracted yet, so population_thousands is absent.

walk_30.source: R6 — WHO Europe physical activity fact sheet, read directly
walk_30.quote: Adults should do at least 150–300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic physical activity ... throughout the week
walk_30.note: WHO states the recommendation for adults aged 18–64; our audience (40–60) sits inside that range. 5 x 30 min = 150 min, the lower bound.

screening.source: R4 — MySejahtera Health Screening page, read directly
screening.quote: Target 1.5 Million individuals to be screened within 6 months. Especially those: Aged 40 years and above ... Do not undergo any health screening in the last 3 years
screening.note: This is why screen 1 collects the 'no screening in 3 years' flag — it mirrors the published eligibility focus.
